description: Send notifications to the user. If 'connector' is specified, sends only to that platform type (e.g. 'telegram', 'slack'). If omitted, sends to ALL configured connectors. IMPORTANT: If this tool returns an error, the message was NOT delivered — report the failure to the user, do not say it succeeded.

connector.description: Optional. Platform type to send to (e.g. 'telegram', 'slack'). Matches the connector type configured in Settings. When omitted, the message is sent to ALL enabled connectors.

message.description: The notification message or report content to send.
